title: 第一卷 第25章 一发入魂大房的风范第一卷 第26章 这小野猫手感还真是不错
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 空间裂缝在议事大厅中央缓缓闭合，古榕和宁天的身影彻底消失不见。
宁风致摇着头轻笑一声，端起桌上的茶杯。
今天的信息量实在太大，他这当宗主的心脏都扑通扑通跳个不停。
喝完茶，宁风致其身，准备招呼剑斗罗带着自己和那三名新觉醒第二武魂的外门长老，抽空前去连杀魂环。
下一刻，异变陡生！
大厅外，突然传来一声极其沉闷的爆声。
紧接着，原本还算温和的天气，温度以一种极其夸张的速度直线暴跌。
厚重的木门缝隙处，竟然以肉眼可见的速度攀爬上一层白霜。
“怎么回事？”
内门三长老打了个哆嗦，这帮老头子，可全都是魂力深厚的高手，居然感觉到了一阵寒意。
没等众人反应过来，外面值守的弟子惊慌失措地喊叫起来。
“快看后山！
那是什么东西！”
宁风致眉头一皱，率先推开大厅的门。
尘心和一众长老呼啦啦全涌了出去。
刚一出门，所有人都齐齐倒吸了一口凉气。
就在宁天寝殿所在的山头上空，一只翼展足有数十米的冰晶凤凰虚影，正悬浮在半空之中。
它正仰着高傲的头颅，发出一声穿透云霄的长鸣。
随着这一声长鸣，方圆几里内的水汽瞬间凝结，硬生生把七宝琉璃宗上空的云层冻成了漫天飞舞的鹅毛大雪！
更为骇人的是，那冰凤凰的虚影凝实得可怕，每一根羽毛都纤毫毕现，周围的空间甚至因为极度的低温而产生了扭曲。
“这是……武魂异象？！”
雷震瞪圆了眼。
去看看！”
尘心脚下剑气勃发，第一个冲了出去。
宁风致等人紧随其后。
等这帮七宝琉璃宗的大佬们火急火燎地赶到后山寝殿时，眼前的景象更夸张。
整个院落全被一层厚厚的玄冰覆盖。
就连院子里那棵百年的桂花树，都变成了晶莹剔透的冰雕。
就在众人打算上前查看的时候，覆盖着冰霜的房门被人从里面推开。
水冰儿缓步走了出来。
这一刻，就连向来眼高于顶的尘心，都忍不住挑了挑眉毛。
此时的水冰儿，整个人的气质发生了翻天覆地的变化。
魂力完全内敛，没有任何外泄，整个人透着一股晶莹剔透的纯粹感。
甚至连发丝上，都流转着莹莹的冰蓝色微光。
水冰儿轻轻吐出一口白气。
她自己比谁都清楚，那盒万年冰灵髓究竟有多逆天！
药力入体的那一刻，不仅将她体内的杂质清扫一空，更是让她的冰凤凰武魂完成了一次极其深度的洗礼。
神与魂合！
她现在的经脉宽阔度，起码是之前的两倍。
content_en:
The space crack slowly closed in the center of the meeting hall, and Gu Rong and Ning Tian disappeared completely.
Ning Fengzhi shook his head and chuckled, picking up the teacup on the table.
The amount of information today was so overwhelming that the heart of his sect leader was beating fast.
After drinking tea, Ning Feng calmed down and prepared to call Sword Douluo to take him and the three outer sect elders who had newly awakened the second martial spirit to take the time to kill the soul rings.
The next moment, a sudden change occurred!
"Boom——"
Outside the hall, there was suddenly an extremely dull explosion.
Immediately afterwards, the temperature, which was originally relatively mild, plummeted at an extremely exaggerated speed.
A layer of white frost climbed up at the gap between the thick wooden door at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"What's going on?"
The third elder of the inner sect shivered. These old men, all masters with profound soul power, actually felt a chill.
Before anyone could react, the disciples on duty outside shouted in panic.
“Look at the back mountain!
What is that! "
Ning Fengzhi frowned and pushed open the hall door first.
Chen Xin and the elders all rushed out with a cheer.
As soon as they walked out, everyone took a breath.
Just above the hilltop where Ningtian's dormitory is located, the shadow of an ice crystal phoenix with a wingspan of tens of meters is suspended in mid-air.
It was raising its proud head and letting out a long roar that penetrated the sky.
Following this long cry, the water vapor within a few miles around instantly condensed, freezing the clouds over the Qibao Glazed Sect into heavy snowflakes flying all over the sky!
What's even more terrifying is that the shadow of the ice phoenix is ​​so solid that every feather is clearly visible, and the surrounding space is even distorted due to the extremely low temperature.
"Is this... a martial soul vision?!"
Lei Zhen's eyes widened.
"Go!
Go check it out! "
Chen Xin's sword energy surged at his feet and he was the first to rush out.
Ning Fengzhi and others followed closely behind.
When these big guys from the Qibao Glazed Sect rushed to the back mountain dormitory in a hurry, the scene in front of them was even more exaggerated.
The entire courtyard was covered by a thick layer of black ice.
Even the century-old osmanthus tree in the yard has turned into a crystal clear ice sculpture.
"Crunch——"
Just when everyone was about to step forward to check, the frost-covered door was pushed open from the inside.
Shui Binger walked out slowly.
At this moment, even Chen Xin, who had always had his eyes high above his head, couldn't help but raise his eyebrows.
At this time, Shui Bing'er's whole temperament had undergone earth-shaking changes.
The soul power is completely restrained, without any leakage, and the whole person exudes a sense of crystal clear purity.
Even the hair was shimmering with ice-blue light.
Shui Bing'er let out a breath of white air.
She knows better than anyone else how powerful that box of ten thousand-year-old ice essence is!
The moment the medicine entered her body, it not only cleared away the impurities in her body, but also completed an extremely deep baptism for her Ice Phoenix Spirit.
God and soul unite!
Her meridians are now at least twice as wide as before.
